text: hey in cart/editor there is an eventbus, i want you to get me an itemized list (bulleted) of what hits this eventbus
resolution: Audited cart/editor's authoring eventbus producers from the runtime/editorbus imports through every dispatch wrapper and AppFrame call site. Identified the four actively emitted event types, itemized their concrete UI/native action sources, and separated local-history fallback rows plus notable editor actions that currently do not publish. Read-only investigation; no source changes.
